messages:
carmen li: Hi team! I started today — Carmen in Platform. Excited to be here 🎉. Quick Q: I haven't received the MDM invite yet, and my laptop is a bit drained. Who should I ping for device enrollment? Also — my plant obsession is real, I brought a little fern 🪴 and I will bring soup to the team at lunch later (miso or tom yum?).
izzy (onboarding buddy): Welcome Carmen!! I got you. Check your email for the MDM invite from mobile-device@redwood.com — if it didn't arrive, ping me and I'll resend. For now grab a spare charger from the ops shelf (labelled "new-hires"). Also +1 to miso. :)
marcos v: hey Carmen, welcome! FYI VPN creds roll out after MDM enrollment. If you need immediate access to dev docs, DM me and I can add a temp rule.
jamie (people ops): Welcome! Lunch plan sounds great — we have a small welcome at 12:30 in the kitchen. Bring your fern but maybe no soil on the table 😅. If you haven't filled the I-9/HR forms check the onboarding portal: https://onboard.redwood/carmen (should be auto-sent).
ops-bot: [automated] Device enrollment email resent to carmen.li@redwood.com at 2026-03-10 09:12:05 UTC.
izzy (onboarding buddy): Steps to enroll (quick):
```
1. Open the MDM email -> click "Enroll device"
2. Download the agent and install
3. Approve device in 1Password (check the Onboarding vault)
4. Reboot and connect to redwood-vpn via WireGuard
```
izzy (onboarding buddy): If the MDM agent errors, post the exact error here or paste logs. Common fix: reinstall the agent and reboot.
marcos v: Carmen — once you're on VPN, run `ssh git@redwood-repo` to check key access. If it prompts for a passphrase it's expected.
carmen li: Thanks all — I found the email in spam (classic). Enrollment started, installing now. Also miso it is. :)
jamie (people ops): Pro tip: folks love samosas but if you bring soup, put it in a labeled thermos. Someone always volunteers to ladle. :ramen:
izzy (onboarding buddy): Also adding you to #platform on Slack in a sec. Expect invites to weekly sync and the retro channel.
carmen li: Enrollment finished, laptop is up. Added my fern photo: https://imgur.com/example-f3rn (pls be gentle, it's tiny).
marcos v: Gorgeous. Welcome again — ping me if any git perms are off.
izzy (onboarding buddy): Quick checklist for today: 1) MDM done ✅ 2) VPN done ✅ 3) Slack channels added ✅ 4) lunch at 12:30 ✅ 5) bring a spoon for communal soup 😅
carmen li: All set, thank you everyone — see you at lunch!
